title: Positive real powers and logarithms to a base greater than one
statement: Let $b,x,y\in\mathbf R$ with $1<b$ and $0<x$. Write $b^y$ for the real power [def-weil-real-power], and put $\log_b x=(\log x)/(\log b)$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm, the inverse of the real exponential on the positive reals. Then $$b^{\log_b x}=x,\qquad \log_b x\leq y\ \Longleftrightarrow\ x\leq b^y.$$
